summary: One review pass completed using the approved target and all 11 camera views. The model substantially misses the target anatomy and silhouette. The supplied deterministic report identifies 10 blockers and one warning; visual inspection also fails face construction, arm clearance, claws, shields, and leg anatomy. Quality Gate B approval remains with the user.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: both upper arms penetrate the torso by 1.45 studs, exceeding the 0.65 maximum. These measurements were not independently rerun.
findings.recommendation: Move the upper arms outward and reshape the shoulder connections to meet the penetration limit.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: all six forward claws have direction dot products of -0.98; both rear claws have -0.95. All eight claws fail their required directions.
findings.recommendation: Correct each claw's orientation individually: three forward and one backward on each foot.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: height/depth ratio is 1.1533, below the 1.35 review threshold. Side views nevertheless show an upright torso without arm support.
findings.recommendation: Review body and tail proportions against the target alongside the ratio warning.

findings.message: The model has stacked rounded limb segments, a blocklike chest, a compressed neck, and a broad rounded muzzle. The target has continuous armored anatomy, an elongated reptilian head and neck, substantial clawed hands, and a sweeping tapered tail.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the primary anatomical proportions and silhouette against the approved target before adding surface detail.

findings.message: The crown reads as a smooth dome; muzzle and jaw read as two inflated horizontal pads. Circular eyes sit on a flat brow strip. This does not form the target's angular reptilian face. Vent orientation and complete bilateral alignment cannot be verified because details are absent or obscured by the review panel.
findings.recommendation: Reshape the crown, muzzle, and jaw into a coherent tapered skull; integrate eyes and vents, then provide unobstructed close-ups.

findings.message: Both arms sit tightly against the chest, with portions merging into the torso silhouette. The close-ups do not establish continuous free-hanging arms clear of the torso; highlighted surfaces also obscure the junctions.
findings.recommendation: Create visible clearance below each shoulder and expose the full upper arm, elbow, forearm, and hand.

findings.message: Both feet's three front claws read as blunt highlighted wedges attached to oval toes rather than forward-tapering talons. Rear claws are not clearly readable as backward-pointing talons, and the close-ups show apparent separation between lower legs and toe assemblies. Panel occlusion prevents complete visual verification of every claw.
findings.recommendation: Connect the foot anatomy, form pointed talons, and capture unobstructed views showing all eight claw tips and roots.

findings.message: The dorsal forms read as narrow triangular fins or simple spikes. They lack the target's broad, irregular shattered shield faces and visible yellow fissures. Seven distinct shield forms cannot be confidently verified.
findings.recommendation: Build seven individually readable angular shields with broken contours, broad faces, and storm fissures.

findings.message: The legs are bulkier than the arms, but stacked spherical segments and weak ankle-to-foot continuity undermine a massive, load-bearing digitigrade structure.
findings.recommendation: Create continuous thigh, knee, raised heel, ankle, and foot transitions with a convincing weight-bearing stance.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, armor, and defining silhouette substantially diverge from the approved target.
Visible facial parts form a rounded, padlike face; correct vent orientation and complete intended symmetry cannot be verified.
Visual clearance is not established, and the supplied deterministic report confirms excessive penetration on both sides.
All six forward claws and both rear claws fail supplied direction checks. Visible claws are blunt or insufficiently exposed for complete verification.
Front and side views show an upright torso supported by the legs, with arms off the ground. The separate height/depth warning remains.
A biped, dorsal ridge, and tail remain, but the target's distinctive armored head, continuous muscular anatomy, shield silhouette, and curved tail are not preserved.
Dorsal forms resemble simple triangular fins; shattered shield construction and seven distinct forms are not verified.
Leg mass exceeds arm mass, but segmented rounded anatomy and disconnected-looking feet do not convincingly establish load-bearing digitigrade legs.
